own_symbolic_findings: Common input permutation changes coordinates, not unconstrained RCTL expressivity if every raw-input projection is adjusted.
Cell-dependent alignment can simplify sharing, but may make one global model sufficient.
Unordered inputs can remove useful roles; equal importance does not identify joint response equivalence.
CRAFT printed attention terms give O(C(P+C/P)) under GP≈C; not a measured end-to-end linear clustering cost.
decision: No recommendation or new numeric pilot: actual role-mismatch harm and incremental partition benefit are not established. Not proof of universal impossibility.
